flowNote: Green is done. Amber is in progress. Grey is not started. Yellow diamonds are decisions, not screens. After a valid OTP the app checks whether the mobile is already registered. Existing user: the app checks for an active rental or material booking (any assigned machine / material order). If yes, Quick Booking opens first; Close/Back goes to Home. If none, go to Home. New user: Sign Up Completed popup — Contact us to Register opens Help & Support, or Register Yourself continues registration and then Home. Invalid OTP stays on the OTP screen. Rental-owner Quick Booking (9000000001) is done — 40 isolated cases. Material Vendor Quick Booking (9000000017) is done — Landing 6, Accept 1, Decline 1, Edge 6. Rental Home (9000000001) is done — Landing 11, Interact 17, Edge 12 (40 cases) plus Material Home 32. Open bugs #25 (Rental Home Back → launcher) and #26 (Rental Home rotation opens Account drawer). Rental Booking structure is scaffolded — 82 cases (RB-L16 / RB-I16 / RB-S16 / RB-E20 / RB-A14), all enabled=false until customer-web credentials seed real bookings. Dev blocker #16 still open on Assign Confirm when operators are busy. Operator Quick Booking is not started.
existingUserEvidenceNote: 18 Sep live on 9000000001: pending rentals open Quick Booking after OTP. 19 Sep on 9000000017: pending material orders open the same Quick Booking page (material chrome, no timer/operator). Accept is one-step (toast Accepted 1 item(s)); Decline uses a material reason list and Confirm Decline. After both 0017 cards were consumed, post-OTP lands on Home. Operator existing-user landing will be added when specified.
